name: Afterschool at the STEM Discovery Center
summary: A one-hour lab led by a scientist, then an hour of open maker space to build, test, and chase whatever caught your kid's interest. New lessons every week.
image_alt: Three students gasp as a classmate holds a wand to a Van de Graaff generator

name: Break and summer camps
when: Thanksgiving, winter, spring, and summer breaks
summary: Half-day camps with hands-on labs, a snack break, and maker space time. Morning and afternoon groups run the same camp, so pick the time that fits.
image_alt: A student throws an arm up in celebration while classmates laugh at a lab table

name: Assemblies and demo lab stations
summary: Two science shows, The Power of Science and Mysteries of Science, brought to your school or event.
image_alt: A class strikes silly poses in front of a slide titled Magnetic Fields during a LabRats visit

name: STEM at Home
summary: Free video labs and printable procedures that use supplies you probably already have in the kitchen.
image_alt: Three students in purple gloves pour a liquid into a jar at an outdoor lab table

name: Courses and workshops
when: Booked with your school, troop, or event
summary: Our Mobile Lab brings any of 100+ hands-on lessons to classrooms, scout troops, and events anywhere in San Diego County.
image_alt: The LabRats Mobile STEAM Lab, a blue van painted with the word STEAM
